Protected by auth modifier, changes the owner state variable.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner and authority inside isAuthorized to grant or deny access.
callProxy reaches the onlyAuthorized modifier which inspects msg.sender authorization.
kill reachable only when owner equals msg.sender via onlyOwner modifier.
getFee queries BotRegistry.botList(tx.origin) to lower the automatic service fee.
Compound getFee queries BotRegistry.botList(tx.origin) to pick automatic fee.
MCD getFee queries BotRegistry.botList(tx.origin) to pick automatic fee.
changeMonitor stores block.timestamp (now) into changeRequestedTimestamp.
confirmNewMonitor compares changeRequestedTimestamp plus CHANGE_PERIOD against now.
_nonce is hashed into the digest and stored in nonces to prevent replay.
kill invokes selfdestruct on the payable owner address.
callProxy performs a low level external call to an arbitrary proxy contract, potential reentrancy.
Local fee divides into amount producing feeAmount in getFee.
feeAmount computed via amount division is the arithmetic fee computation.
Admin address parameter is written into authorization configuration by owner functions.
owner state variable is the gate checked by onlyOwner before kill executes.
withdrawStuckFunds transfers funds to owner, gated by onlyOwner.
isAuthorized delegates permission to authority.canCall when owner does not match.
nonces mapping is read and written by callProxy for each user nonce.
changeRequestedTimestamp is validated before confirming a new monitor.
allowed mapping is checked by onlyAllowed before changeMonitor proceeds.
withdrawStuckFunds calls SafeERC20 transfer to move tokens to the owner.

normalization_plan.reason: _nonce is only consumed inside callProxy for digest and replay protection.
Local fee is only used to derive feeAmount within getFee.
feeAmount is a local output computed solely inside getFee.
Admin parameter is consumed by the owner-only authorization setter.
